_note_portfolioResidualQuantileWad: PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDER, not calibrated (see _provisional above; replaced by the Phase 4 grid sweep). Derivation: forecast.ts's lowerBoundAt computes horizonMu = annualisedRateWad * horizonSeconds / SECONDS_PER_YEAR, then adds this quantile (<=0). At horizonSeconds=604800 (7d) the conversion factor is 604800/31536000 = 0.0191781, so a reference 5% APY venue (WAD-scale rate 5e16, mid-range for these lending markets) has a 7-day horizon return of 5e16 * 0.0191781 = 9.589e14. The PREVIOUS value here, -2e15, was LARGER IN MAGNITUDE than that entire reference return (and than an 8% APY venue's 1.534e15) so it drove every venue's lower bound negative and the optimiser deployed nothing, forever, with no error -- see task-11-report.md. This value, -1e13, is about 1% of the 5% reference horizon return: solving horizonMu + q = 0 for r gives a breakeven APY of only ~0.052%, so it stays out of the way of any realistically-yielding venue while remaining a strictly negative (conservative) shrink. It is NOT a calibrated dispersion estimate -- it exists only to let the pipeline admit and deploy capital in Phase 1; a later phase replaces it with a real quantile from completed-label residuals. AS OF 2026-09-08 this value is only a FALLBACK: when the artifact carries a `residualPanel` (which `evaluation/kernel/harness.ts#prepareArtifact` builds from the calibration split), `steps/portfolio-quantile.ts#portfolioResidualQuantileFor` computes q^p_alpha(w) from that panel under the candidate's own weights and this scalar is not used. It still governs when no panel can be calibrated -- including a window with no observed dispersion, where falling back to 0n would be the most optimistic value available rather than the most conservative.
_note_noTradeBandK: NOT CALIBRATED. Paper 9.1 requires k to be "a registered scalar multiplier fixed before held-out evaluation"; 1.0 here carries no such registration and was never swept. Calibrating it needs a held-out turnover-vs-return sweep over a real collected dataset (the input this repo does not have yet: srcla has no multi-month MarketSnapshot series with the paper's registered horizons). Until that sweep runs, k=1.0 is a placeholder and any P8 result is provisional -- do NOT pick a value here because it makes a gate pass. The band's OTHER input, sigma_hat, is no longer a placeholder: steps/portfolio-quantile.ts derives it from the calibration split's residual panel under the target's own weights.
